import json
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from pathlib import Path
from jobbot.config import load_bundle
from jobbot.search_plan import compile_staged_plan, plan_counts, write_plan

root = Path('.')
evidence = root / 'verification' / 'CHG-170-r1'
before = json.loads((evidence / 'before-search-plan.json').read_text())
bundle = load_bundle(root)
tasks = compile_staged_plan(bundle)
paths = write_plan(tasks, evidence, 'staged')
for key, path in paths.items():
    target = evidence / f'after-search-plan.{key}'
    path.replace(target)

before_tasks = before.get('tasks', [])
before_summary = {
    'mode': before.get('mode', 'staged'),
    'total_tasks': len(before_tasks),
    'by_platform': dict(sorted(Counter(str(t.get('platform', 'unknown')) for t in before_tasks).items())),
    'by_legacy_lane': dict(sorted(Counter(str(t.get('lane', 'unknown')) for t in before_tasks).items())),
    'explicit_strategy_profile_family_pass_dimensions': all(
        all(t.get(k) for k in ('strategy_profile', 'query_family', 'query_kind', 'query_pass'))
        for t in before_tasks
    ) if before_tasks else False,
}
counts = plan_counts(tasks)
by_phase = Counter(t.phase for t in tasks)
platforms = sorted({t.platform for t in tasks})
families = sorted({t.query_family for t in tasks})
deep_by_platform = {
    platform: sorted({t.query_family for t in tasks if t.platform == platform and t.phase == 'C_DEEP_BACKFILL'})
    for platform in platforms
}
fields = list(tasks[0].__dataclass_fields__) if tasks else []
representatives = {}
for platform in platforms:
    selected = [t for t in tasks if t.platform == platform][:5]
    representatives[platform] = [
        {'query_family': t.query_family, 'query_kind': t.query_kind, 'query': t.query}
        for t in selected
    ]
summary = {
    'before': before_summary,
    'after': {
        'mode': 'staged',
        'strategy_profile': tasks[0].strategy_profile if tasks else '',
        'strategy_profile_version': tasks[0].strategy_profile_version if tasks else '',
        'total_tasks': counts['total'],
        'by_platform': counts['by_platform'],
        'by_family': counts['by_family'],
        'by_pass': counts['by_pass'],
        'phase_counts': dict(sorted(by_phase.items())),
        'deep_families_by_platform': deep_by_platform,
        'all_queries_remote_only_unlimited': all(t.remote_required and t.max_results is None for t in tasks),
        'exposed_fields': sorted(fields),
        'by_platform_family_pass_phase': counts['platform_family_pass'],
    },
    'coverage_change': {
        'baseline_tasks_were_lane_title_queries_without_family_pass_provenance': not before_summary['explicit_strategy_profile_family_pass_dimensions'],
        'candidate_has_enabled_deep_recall_families': len(families),
        'each_enabled_family_is_present_in_deep_phase_on_all_three_platforms': all(set(deep_by_platform.get(p, [])) == set(families) for p in ('linkedin', 'indeed', 'glassdoor')),
    },
    'representative_queries': representatives,
    'interpretation': 'The old and new totals are plan sizes, not result-quality evidence. The new plan adds inspectable family/pass coverage and uses smaller platform-appropriate exact queries; no yield claim is inferred from raw counts.',
}
(evidence / 'plan-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\\n')
print(json.dumps({'total': counts['total'], 'by_platform': counts['by_platform'], 'by_family': counts['by_family'], 'by_pass': counts['by_pass'], 'phase_counts': dict(by_phase), 'deep_family_counts': {p: len(v) for p,v in deep_by_platform.items()}, 'files': sorted(p.name for p in evidence.iterdir())}, indent=2))
PY"
